title: Remote critical banner
summary: One banner above the chat list for critical notices only: an outage, a forced update, a change of terms (ADR 0117). The text comes from the server; the app decides how to show it from the shared rule.

bannerState.description: remoteBannerState(banner, app version, now): hidden (none, expired or dismissed), notice (opens link, can be closed), update (app below min_app_version: opens the update link, no close).

id.description: The banner id. A closed notice stays closed for this id.

title.description: From the server, pt-BR only, at most 60 characters.

text.description: From the server, pt-BR only, at most 240 characters.

link.description: https link for a notice, or the platform update link for an update.

refresh.effect: On launch and on foreground: GET /v1/banner (no auth), then computes bannerState. A failed fetch keeps the last state.

open.effect: Opens link in the system browser, or the store page for an update.

dismiss.effect: notice only: stores the id on this phone and hides the banner.

notes: The rule is remoteBannerState() in tools/lib/registries.mjs with cases in test-vectors/remote-banner.json. Bipe logic: BipeRemoteBanner.state(appVersion:now:) and BipeAPIClient.remoteBanner (iOS); BipeRemoteBannerStore and BipeRemoteBanner.state (Android, api/BipeApiModels.kt), BipeOnForeground. Move them.
The app version is product/version.json (the generated version name).
The banner slot above the list holds account tasks too (recovery key, inviter row, ADR 0117). The remote banner comes first; it is the only item from the server.
News never uses this banner; it goes to the Novidades chat (ADR 0117).
